meta.name: Taha Mohammadi Frontend Design DNA
meta.description: Greenfield bilingual academic and professional platform. Exact tokens come from agent-kit; visual inferences come from the curated Light/Dark home, gateway, page-family and graph-editor concepts.

primary.role: Light theme brand action and focus; Dark theme uses #16b8a6.

secondary.role: Light theme ink; Dark theme structural navy is #071225.

accent.role: Scarce gold signature and editorial emphasis; never the sole state indicator.

neutral.usage: Warm editorial Light surfaces and layered deep-navy Dark surfaces.

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast reading text with layered surfaces; teal, gold, violet, emerald and coral supplement rather than replace semantic contrast.

font_families.heading: Newsreader Variable for English; Estedad Variable for Persian
font_families.body: Inter Variable for English; Vazirmatn Variable for Persian

typography.font_style_notes: Editorial serif display paired with clear variable sans body; source, license and subset are gated before runtime activation.

spacing.section_rhythm: Large narrative section separation with compact intra-card rhythm.

layout.alignment_tendency: strict editorial grid with asymmetric hero art and radial research graph.

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px semantic borders; controls retain visible boundary in both themes.
shape.divider_style: Low-contrast horizontal or grid-aligned dividers, never sole grouping signal.

elevation.shadow_style: Subtle layered shadow in Light; tonal depth, glow and border in Dark

levels.medium: surface plus soft shadow or tonal offset

elevation.depth_cues: Layered navy, restrained glow, arches, orbital lines and carefully bounded glass.

iconography.preferred_set: One accessible SVG icon system with visible labels where meaning is not universally obvious.

motion.entrance_pattern: Subtle opacity/translation only when motion is permitted
motion.exit_pattern: Subtle opacity reduction without layout shift
motion.philosophy: Minimal functional motion; reduced motion removes transforms and continuous graph animation.

components.button_style: Clearly bordered or filled action with text label, icon support and 44px minimum target
components.input_style: Persistent label, visible border, explicit error/help text
components.card_style: Editorial surface with restrained border and independent title/action targets
components.navigation_pattern: Utility-rich header with active route indicator; locale and theme remain explicit
components.modal_style: Accessible dialog only for true interruption; no concept-derived decorative modal
components.list_style: Ordered editorial rows, cards or definition groups before enhancement
components.component_notes: Raster concepts describe hierarchy, not reusable markup. The agent kit remains the component/template inventory.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A luminous portal into a connected research constellation
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary editorial science and refined digital atlas

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous Light canvas and deliberate Dark breathing room
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Typography and researched imagery balance; graph/portal concentrates the hero
visual_language.focal_strategy: Single hero plus progressive sectional evidence
visual_language.contrast_level: High for reading and controls; low for decorative atmosphere
visual_language.texture_usage: Fine atmospheric grain, orbital lines and architectural imagery only as bounded accents.

composition.hierarchy_method: Display scale, spatial isolation, color weight and repeated section-label rhythm
composition.balance_type: Asymmetric editorial hero with radial graph balance
composition.flow_direction: Locale-aware logical flow; content order does not change by theme
composition.grouping_strategy: Section labels, aligned cards, dividers, contained surfaces and semantic landmarks
composition.negative_space_role: Supports scanning, reading measure and focal clarity rather than filling the page.

imagery.photo_treatment: Curated architectural and abstract technical renders with controlled palette
imagery.illustration_style: Fine-line technical symbols and constellation relationships
imagery.graphic_elements: Portal arches, orbital lines, nodes, restrained grid, signature gold marks
imagery.pattern_usage: Low-opacity network motifs confined to support surfaces
imagery.image_shape: Editorial rectangles with consistent aspect-ratio reservation; no text baked into runtime UI.

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Clear focus, selected state, inline validation and honest status
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Small tonal/border change; no large scale or disorienting movement
interaction_feel.loading_style: Stable geometry and textual state; no false progress
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Low; interactions earn their motion through utility.

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Specific invitation tied to a legitimate next action
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Honest unavailable, empty, private and translation states with one recovery action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Safe, concise, actionable and free of internal detail.

overview.fallback_strategy: Static CSS/semantic list with all information and links retained
overview.primary_technology: CSS plus optional Canvas/SVG/React island for graph Phase 1

background_effects.description: Deep navy or warm ivory atmosphere with very low-opacity orbital and architectural support
background_effects.technology: CSS gradients and static image assets

particle_systems.description: Conceptual dots belong to the semantic research graph, not a free decorative particle field.

3d_elements.description: No 3D runtime requirement. Phase 2 remains separate and cannot outrun accessible Phase 1.

shader_effects.description: No shader is required by the approved references.

scroll_morphing.description: Content and hierarchy must not depend on scroll motion.

text_effects.description: Typography communicates hierarchy without animated splitting.

cursor_effects.description: No custom cursor, trail or magnetic control is permitted.

image_effects.description: Reserve aspect ratio and use accessible static media; hover is limited to tonal treatment.

canvas_drawings.description: The graph is not a freeform canvas requirement; an accepted Phase 1 may introduce a bounded renderer after semantic list parity exists.

svg_animations.description: Logo and icons remain static by default.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The visual references show atmosphere through portals, orbit lines and connected research nodes. Implement those as static CSS/SVG or approved responsive media first. Any enhanced graph must expose identical relationships and navigation through semantic HTML, honor reduced motion, and fall back immediately when the renderer is unavailable.
